name: Fluentoo TOEIC
description: Hosted Fluentoo MCP for TOEIC Listening & Reading preparation: converts a TOEIC score to a CEFR level and certificate colour, estimates a score from correct answers, describes the 7 parts of the test, and links to guides and the free practice test.
